text_to_speech: Omar, it’s great that the EAGLE directly controls the power of my dew heaters but astrophotographers ask us to automate everything. ECCO! It would be important to calculate the dew point. That’s the temperature where dew condenses on the optics. ECCO! And then automatically control the power for the dew heaters avoiding dew problems all night long. We have to build a compact device that is easy to install on any telescope, ECCO! 2 ECCO is this compact and lightweight device that we designed to automate control of dew heaters connected to the EAGLE. ECCO can be easily installed on any telescope since it connects to a standard finder shoe. It’s an external device, separate from the EAGLE because it has to measure environmental data like temperature, humidity and pressure with its integrated sensors. You can connect up to 3 external temperature sensors to the ECCO and, on the other side, you insert the temperature probe between the telescope and the dew heater band you want to automatically control. By comparing probe readings with data coming from its integrated sensors, ECCO calculates dew point and automatically regulates power of dew heaters connected to the EAGLE. ECCO is a simple to use plug&play device. ECCO comes with a sturdy USB-C type port: connect it to the EAGLE with the provided USB cable and press ECCO button in the EAGLE Manager. Now ECCO shows air temperature, humidity and pressure. If the ECCO detects that a dew heater is associated with a temperature probe, it automatically takes control of dew heaters power by keeping your optics at a temperature just above the dew point, preventing dew from condensing on your telescope. ECCO comes with more advanced features like SMART control of temperature probes to automatically detect uncalibrated or wrongly connected temperature probes, DARK mode to disable the ECCO LED light and ASCOM driver that allows you to use it with third party software or even with standard Windows computers! And all of this in the compact and plug&play environmental computerized controller, ECCO!

youtube_description:
ECCO2 is the Environmental Computerized COntroller for EAGLE that automates the management of dew heaters during long exposure astrophotography. By adding the ECCO module to your EAGLE, it will automatically and continuously monitor the temperature, humidity and pressure around your telescope and the temperature of your lenses by calculating the dew point (the temperature below which dew condenses). This way it will vary the heating of dew heaters connected to the dew heater ports of the EAGLE avoiding condensation on your optics. It is automatic with this easy to use device. Just connect it to the EAGLE's USB port. For this reason we decided to call it ECCO. In Italian, it means "There you go!” 

The second generation ECCO now comes with USB-C type port, added pressure sensor, SMART control of temperature probes and DARK mode. ECCO2 is also provided with an ASCOM driver to control it also with third party software, also from standard Windows 10 computers!

Discover ECCO2 in our website: https://www.primalucelab.com/astronomy/ecco2-environmental-computerized-controller-for-eagle.html
